base.$description: Default stacking level for page content.

dropdown.$description: Dropdown menus and select lists, above page content.

sticky.$description: Sticky headers and toolbars, above dropdowns that scroll under them.

modal.$description: Modal dialogs and sheets, above their scrim.

popover.$description: Popovers and menus, above modals so they work inside one.

toast.$description: Toasts and snackbars, above modals so notifications stay visible.
